scenarios.title: Windowless courtyard scene integrity
scenarios.description: Loads the rebuilt game pack with Godot's headless dummy renderer. Checks scene assets, HUD bounds and preserved collisions; supplies no pixel or GPU evidence.

scenarios.title: Classic controls, contact-timed kicks and physical handling
scenarios.description: One bounded rendered sequence exercising turns, stops, free-running versus carrying, a slide against a moving carrier, three challenges, contextual PlayStation actions and low/lofted kick flight. Saves 36 production scene and animation frames; does not inject hardware input or benchmark hardware.

scenarios.title: Reactive controller against normal match AI
scenarios.description: Thirty seconds of current-state controller decisions, normal teammate/opponent AI, production match rules and physics. No hardware input; captures actions and rendered match frames, not subjective fun.

scenarios.title: Physical falls, hop clearance and recovery
scenarios.description: Finite rendered contact scenarios, skill thresholds, R1 hops, board recovery and restart cleanup.

scenarios.title: Athlete models, planted gait and physical action poses
scenarios.description: One bounded rendered sequence: both teams, turns, dribbling, kick, slide, hop and ragdoll recovery. No hardware input or full-match regression.

scenarios.title: First skinned athlete and full-body physical shot
scenarios.description: One finite model, locomotion, dribble, weak/charged/moving/missed shot and ragdoll sequence.

scenarios.title: Physical kick variety, directional actions and team play
scenarios.description: One finite kick/tactics sequence followed by 30 seconds of normal physical AI play.

scenarios.title: Six athletes: human slides, jumps and movement variation
scenarios.description: One finite rendered sequence: all six walking, sprinting, turning, stopping, sliding, jumping and ball contacts.

scenarios.title: Wall recovery, defensive switching and active pass reception
scenarios.description: One finite physical wall, switch, reception and autonomous team sequence.

scenarios.title: Committed slides, physical shoves and breakable grabs
scenarios.description: One finite clean/miss, fall/glance/hop, push and grab contact sequence.

scenarios.title: Core handling and decision-driven match
scenarios.description: Physical turns, stops, sprint, cushion/redirect, first-time play, foot selection and misses, then 30 seconds of decision-driven match play.
